name: @ortho-earth/plugin-splat
description: Gaussian splats for @ortho-earth/globe: fills the reserved map.addData kind "splat" (SplatData or .ply / .splat / .spz URLs), drawn as a same-frame overlay (WebGPU: spherical harmonics, GPU sort, shared device and depth; WebGL2 fallback) with scene depth, unified picking, a worker reader and LoD.
